final_answer:
Across the 3,948-patient score table, the sepsis endotyping signatures cluster into four main correlation-defined groups when signatures are hierarchically clustered by Spearman score correlation across patients.

1. Adaptive / IA / lymphoid-protective cluster:
mod4_score, protective_score, adaptive_score, yao_IA_score, mars3_score, lymphoid_protective_score.
This was the tightest multi-signature block (mean within-cluster rho about 0.778), with especially strong links between mod4_score and lymphoid_protective_score (rho 0.962), mod4_score and protective_score (0.875), and adaptive_score and yao_IA_score (0.856).

2. Myeloid/monocyte/neutrophil-protective plus Wong/MARS4 cluster:
mod3_score, wong_score, mars4_score, neutrophil_protective_score, monocyte_protective_score, myeloid_protective_score.
This was a looser but coherent second block (mean within-cluster rho about 0.447), anchored by monocyte_protective_score with myeloid_protective_score (0.893) and neutrophil_protective_score with myeloid_protective_score (0.732).

3. Compact Yao-IC / MARS1 pair:
yao_IC_score and mars1_score.
These two signatures clustered tightly together (rho 0.757).

4. Inflammopathic / detrimental / SRS / system-wide dysregulation cluster:
mod1_score, mod2_score, detrimental_score, som_score, inflammopathic_score, coagulopathic_score, yao_IN_score, davenport_SRSq, cano_SRSq, mars2_score, myeloid_detrimental_score, lymphoid_score, myeloid_score, lymphoid_z_score, myeloid_z_score.
This broad block captured the detrimental/system-wide end of the consensus framework (mean within-cluster rho about 0.622), with strong internal correlations such as detrimental_score with myeloid_detrimental_score (0.943) and davenport_SRSq with cano_SRSq (0.922).

The overall map therefore separates a protective/adaptive/IA axis from an inflammopathic/SRS/detrimental axis; these two poles are strongly anti-correlated, for example adaptive_score versus inflammopathic_score rho = -0.842 and adaptive_score versus davenport_SRSq rho = -0.820.

A caveat is that some columns are clearly derived versions of the same underlying score (for example lymphoid_score vs lymphoid_z_score, rho = 1.000; myeloid_score vs myeloid_z_score, rho = 1.000; lymphoid_protective_score vs lymphoid_score, rho = -1.000). Even after removing these obvious redundancies in sensitivity analysis, the same four broad groupings remained.
